channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Matt Thomas | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Matt Thomas from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Georges Niang on Matt Thomas
item.description:
Georges Niang on Matt Thomas:

“He has Jazz DNA. He's a great person, he can really shoot the ball and I think the way we play really fits his game.”

Georges Niang on Matt Thomas, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @BensHoops.

item.title: Georges Niang on Matt Thomas
item.description:
Eric Walden:Georges Niang on ex-ISU teammate Matt Thomas and new Jazz teammate:

“Just a great player and a great person. When I passed the ball, he made a lot of shots.”

Georges Niang on Matt Thomas, Mar 26, 2021. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Nick Nurse on Matt Thomas, Terence Davis
item.description:
Tim Bontemps:Nick Nurse on Thomas & Davis:

“They've made way too many mistakes defensively. They're our two best shooters probably but they're just coming out and fouling and giving up boatloads of pointsin a short amount of minutes, and they can't get that many back on the other end.”

Nick Nurse on Matt Thomas, Terence Davis, Jan 4, 2021. Source: Twitter @TimBontemps.
